name: session-profiler
description: See where the time went in a Codex or Claude Code session: an interactive local timeline of prompts, subagents, tool calls, waits and background jobs.

interface.shortDescription: Find where a session's time went
interface.longDescription: Reads your local Codex and Claude Code session logs and opens an interactive timeline of prompts, subagents, tool calls, waits and background jobs, so you can see what took the time. Read only; the report is served on 127.0.0.1.
defaultPrompt: Why did this chat take so long?
